torque_floor.rule: 1.25 x the torque with the throttle shut (the load loop at a request of 0 Nm) at max(1200 rpm, rpm_min) and the car's table ambient, the B58's rule (engine_specs/b58.toml [loop] torque_floor_nm); an extrapolation below every fired calibration row

e6_probes.d_rows: +-10 % (d needs agents; the contract's E6, decision 59)

numerical_noise.rule: decision 85: the housing equivalent of the climb cell's median resolution over CLIMB_S at the frozen plant, |f| x the gas's + |dTh per unit ln mdot| x the flow's / the flow (epa_coefficients.climb_cell_resolution); a probe is visible when |h(+) - h(-)| / 2 exceeds it

e6_probes.range_rule: decision 88: a worth-R1 probe (rows 5, 6, 9) fails (a) bounds when v0 +- size leaves epa_fit.BOUNDS where the constant has an entry, (b) sign when v0 +- size is of the other sign than v0 or zero, (c) finite when the probed plant's cycle at the frozen climb cell's inputs (epa_coefficients.cyc) is not finite in torque, gas, flow and fuel on either side (the completion runs no climb at the probe size); any failure takes the +-10 % fallback, counted excluded for the level rows
